oddwire:item-handbooktext-oddwire:plow-*:
Hold right-click and drag across soil or farmland to plow it into Plowland.

Plowland is a high-retention furrow: it pulls moisture and N/P/K from the soil block beneath it, so crops cycle faster and yield more harvests per season.

Plowing combines the target's nutrients with the supporting block's fertility, and the average decides whether the plot tiers up or down. Plowing a furrow reverts the two neighbours alongside it back to farmland.
oddwire:block-handbooktext-oddwire:plowl:
High-retention farmland furrow made with a Plow.

Holds moisture and N/P/K longer than plain farmland by drawing on the soil block beneath it. Plant, water, and harvest as normal; fertilise with Compost or Bonemeal.

Crops grow, take cold/heat damage, and can die exactly as they do on farmland.
oddwire:block-handbooktext-oddwire:compo:
Turns Food, Rot, and Dry Grass into Compost.

Craft starter pile from Dry Grass and Rot
Once placed adding Rot seeds it, Dry Grass adds bulk, and adding Food increases rate and temperature.

Optimals: Temperature: Cold 20°C / Hot 55°C - Moisture: Dry 60% / Drowning 85% - Aeration: Hypoxic 35% - Rot: Unseesed lt. 80% full

Digging up pile drops processed Compost and Compost Pile.
Refill with the dropped compost and fresh input to restore Aeration.
